The graph version exists: Cassi (1992), after Hattori, Hattori and Watanabe (1987), proves that spectral dimension at most 2 excludes spontaneous magnetization for O(n) and Heisenberg models (as Gelfert and Nolting report it), and Nachtergaele's proof needs no translation invariance. But the theorem needs a continuous symmetry generated by a sum of local generators, equilibrium through the fluctuation-dissipation theorem, and finite second moments (Halperin), and it has exceptions (orientational order in 2D crystals, tethered membranes); Toner and Tu show the 2D logarithm of the linear theory removed out of equilibrium. So the supposition's mathematics is a held theorem, its application to a representation still supposed.
